market: Bellingham / Whatcom County WA, with Skagit overlap
method: Homepage measured in-browser on the same harness as King of Kings (title/meta lengths, H1/H2 counts, body word count, image + alt counts, JSON-LD node inventory, same-host internal link count, sitemap URL count). whatcomgrc.com and nwwindowcleaningbellingham.com were blocked from browser navigation by the extension's site permissions and were measured through WebFetch instead — their schema and image figures are therefore lower-confidence and are marked.
rubric: Keystone Part 10 eleven-dimension scorecard, 1-5 each, averaged to 2 decimals

competitors.name: Mt. Baker Window Cleaning
competitors.title: Window Cleaning Company Bellingham, WA | Mt. Baker Windows
competitors.read: The market leader and the only site that is a genuine threat. Full LocalBusiness + Organization + Place + GeoCoordinates + FAQPage graph, a Person node, PostalAddress, 68 images with zero missing alt, 107 internal links off the homepage, and a 1,000+ review claim. It out-structures King of Kings on every technical dimension despite having 74 fewer URLs.

competitors.name: Pacific Northwest ProWash
competitors.title: Top Rated Pressure Washing in Whatcom and Skagit County - Pacific Northwest ProWash | Get $25 Off Today!
competitors.h1_text: Gutter cleaning and Christmas light installer
competitors.read: Deepest single page in the set (3,601 words on the homepage) and a complete LocalBusiness + FAQPage graph. Two exploitable defects: a 104-character title that truncates in the SERP, and an H1 that says "Gutter cleaning and Christmas light installer" on a page whose title sells pressure washing — the intent signal and the heading contradict each other.

competitors.name: Pure Shine NW
competitors.title: Window Cleaning | Washing | Bellingham | Pure Shine NW
competitors.read: Real off-page authority (501 reviews) sitting on a 30-page site with an Organization node but no LocalBusiness, no NAP in schema and no geo surface at all. The closest analogue to King of Kings' own problem, at one tenth the page count. 94 images on the homepage with a 188-character meta description.

competitors.name: Northwest Window Cleaning
competitors.title: Northwest Window Cleaning, Bellingham WA | Whatcom County
competitors.confidence: medium — measured via WebFetch, not in-browser
competitors.read: Zero structured data. Stuffs sixteen city names into a single meta description instead of building city pages — the exact behaviour a real geo lattice beats. Names Geneva, which King of Kings does not cover.

competitors.name: Whatcom Gutter & Roof Cleaning
competitors.confidence: medium — measured via WebFetch, not in-browser
competitors.read: Twelve URLs, no geo layer at all. The one thing worth noting: they sell gutter installation and gutter-guard installation, and they split moss removal from moss prevention. King of Kings sells neither installation service and treats moss prevention as a paragraph inside moss removal.

competitors.name: Bellingham Window and Gutter Cleaning
competitors.read: A four-page Wix site with 235 words on the homepage and no H1 element at all. Ranks on brand and domain-name match only. Not a competitive threat; included because it holds a Bellingham exact-match domain.

headline: King of Kings has the second-largest page count in the market (287 vs Mt. Baker's 213 — in fact the largest) and the second-largest review base (248 vs Mt. Baker's 1,000+), and still scores fourth of seven. The gap is not content and it is not authority. It is that 287 pages of genuinely local copy are attached to no business entity: zero LocalBusiness nodes, zero Service nodes, zero aggregateRating, on a flat URL space with no hierarchy for that authority to travel through.

what_to_steal.technique: GeoCoordinates + PostalAddress + Place on the LocalBusiness node, and a Person node wired as Article author. Cheapest structural win in the set and King of Kings has none of it.
107 internal links off the homepage. Their hub actually distributes equity; King of Kings' homepage links to 15 pages while carrying 292 inbound links.
A 3,600-word homepage. Depth on the hub, not just on the spokes.
Splitting moss removal from moss prevention as two commercial intents, and selling gutter installation and gutter guards as separate services.

do_not_copy: Pacific Northwest ProWash's 104-character title and its H1/title intent mismatch.
Northwest Window Cleaning's sixteen-city meta description in place of city pages.
Any competitor's absent guarantee terms — the whole market makes unqualified claims, which is an opening, not a licence.
